description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Viewdeletepackage' responsible for handling the display logic of the 'delete package' view in the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder module. It outputs JavaScript to inform the user that a package has been deleted.

classes.name: Viewdeletepackage
classes.description: A view class extending SugarView, responsible for rendering the package deleted message in the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns parameters for the module title, including translation of 'LBL_MODULE_NAME' and the module title from ModuleBuilderController.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates JavaScript output using AjaxCompose to notify the user that a package was deleted, inserting the package name into the message.
